order.title: The caret and selection follow their text when a frontmatter toggle, property edit, link rewrite or external reload rewrites the open note
order.rationale: Upheld content/medium. Cmd+D and Cmd+E are daily and leave the caret about 16 characters off, so the next typing goes to the wrong place and autosave writes it to disk. It is an editor bug, so it comes first.

order.title: Keyboard edits next to the hidden frontmatter never change its fences
order.rationale: Upheld content/medium. Cmd+Up+Enter or a held Backspace breaks the hidden fence on any note with properties, and autosave writes broken frontmatter. The e2e at frontmatter.spec.ts:53-65 pins only where the cursor lands, not edits, so it stays valid.

order.title: Quick Capture writes page titles, app ids and URLs into template frontmatter as valid YAML
order.rationale: Upheld content/medium. Quick Capture is daily, and browser titles with ': ' are common. Each such capture writes corrupt or truncated frontmatter, and every writer then refuses the note. It comes after the editor items only because the editor is the owner's first priority.

order.title: Closing the main window never leaves a windowless app: Quick Capture, deep links and a Dock click keep working
order.rationale: Three waves found the same root cause: tauri-listeners.service.ts:48-55 destroys the window, and there is no RunEvent::Reopen. The red button is the usual macOS gesture, and after it captures are dropped.
order.owner_question: Red close button: (a) quit the app after the exit flush (invoke confirm_exit, frontend only; the Quick Capture shortcuts stop with the app), or (b) hide the main window, show it again on a Dock click through RunEvent::Reopen, and keep captures and deep links writing (Rust plus the allow-hide capability). Either way, the tests at tauri-listeners.service.test.ts:224-311 that pin destroy() change. Decide Issue 44 (Dock Quit, logout and shutdown skip the exit flush) together with this one: with (b), Dock right-click Quit becomes the natural way to quit.
order.critique_notes: This is content loss placed in the ux bucket. Per merged N-file-io-08 (lib.rs:45, :62-81; +layout.svelte:59,63), after the usual red-button close every clipboard capture and deep link is silently dropped. The dedupe anchor has already advanced, so retrying on the same clipboard is skipped too. Quick Capture is daily, so the owner question should be asked with content-bucket urgency.

order.title: Live-preview controls change only the text the user asked to change: fence attributes, task markers and tab-indented pastes stay intact
order.rationale: Still present, content/medium. These are silent rewrites of note text from daily live-preview controls. They are undoable, so they rank below the caret and fence bugs.

order.title: A canvas edit closed or renamed inside the debounce window reaches its .canvas file
order.rationale: Content/medium for a daily canvas user, because the last edit is dropped. Issue 49's bugs 1 and 2 are fixed (f37acb402), and what remains of 49 is exactly this close-within-debounce drop.

order.title: An empty --- --- frontmatter block is matched, and writers never stack a second block
order.rationale: Content/medium. The first icon on a folder without a folder note writes '---\n---\n', and later writers then stack a second block on disk.

order.title: File History keeps a snapshot of the pre-save bytes, and retention never deletes a note's last snapshot
order.rationale: Content/medium. This is the safety net for the bugs above: today an imported or long-unsaved note has no history, so a mistaken overwrite cannot be recovered. It does not lose text by itself, so it is last among the content items.

order.title: A kanban card or lane title being edited is saved into its own board when the tab changes, and never into another tab
order.rationale: Upheld content/low, but severe: board markdown can be written into the note now in front. It reuses the pre-close flush that Issue 22 builds.

order.title: Images in notes display for a vault under ~/kokobrain-vaults: the asset-protocol scope adds that root and keeps the folders the README documents
order.rationale: Upheld ux/high. The owner's vault is under ~/kokobrain-vaults, so no convertFileSrc image displays there. It is a one-line config fix with the largest daily impact.
order.critique_notes: The Issue's what_to_build says to cut the assetProtocol scope down to the two vault roots plus the app cache, dropping $DOCUMENT/**, $DESKTOP/**, $PICTURE/** and $DOWNLOAD/**. help/documentation/README.md:50-62 documents those folders for file:// images, and deep-link kind=shot embeds absolute file:// paths (23-deep-links.md:207-209). As written, this ready-for-agent Issue removes documented behavior without saying so, and that contradicts the plan's own 'one-line config fix' rationale. Add the ~/kokobrain-vaults root; narrowing the scope is a separate owner decision, not part of this Issue.

order.title: Rendered table cells show links, highlight, underscore emphasis, line breaks and escaped pipes as formatted content
order.rationale:
Upheld ux/high. Tables are daily, and links,
and escaped pipes written by the app's own TSV paste show as raw text. The fix reverses a pinned test.
order.owner_question:
Table cells: (a) render links, ==highlight==, underscore emphasis,
and escaped pipes. This reverses the inline-markdown.test.ts:60 case that pins ==highlight== as unsupported. (b) Render only links,
and escaped pipes, and keep ==highlight== unsupported.

order.title: Backlinks and Outgoing links always show the open note's own links, also after returning to a note seen at the same index version
order.rationale: Two waves found the same per-path skip cache in front of one shared store. Plain A to B to A browsing shows the wrong note's links. Land it before ux-polish Issue 06, which edits the same fetch functions.

order.title: Closing a tab with unsaved text saves it and closes; a prompt appears only when that save fails
order.rationale: Upheld ux/high. Cmd+W within 2 s of typing always prompts, and the debounced save can fire while the dialog is open. The fix changes documented behavior and a pinned test.
order.owner_question: Closing a dirty tab: (a) save it and close, and prompt only when the save fails. This changes help/documentation/03-editor.md:129 and the test at editor.service.test.ts:658. (b) Keep the Save/Discard prompt, but cancel the pending debounced save while it is open, so Discard really discards.

order.title: Canvas image nodes load their image: the main capability grants fs:allow-read-file on the vault roots
order.rationale: Upheld ux/high. Every canvas image node shows the placeholder because plugin:fs|read_file is not granted. Canvas is daily.

order.title: Canvas file and image nodes store vault-relative paths and resolve both absolute and vault-relative ones
order.rationale: High likelihood: every picked or dropped node gets an absolute path and fails to load, which is a display failure rather than lost text. Its Blocked-by 13 only avoided a merge conflict in canvas.logic.ts, so it is dropped, and owner decision D7 (b) is recorded.

order.title: Kanban drag-and-drop puts a card or lane exactly where the drop indicator shows
order.rationale: Upheld ux/high. Moving a card down inside a lane, or moving any lane, lands in the wrong slot on a daily-used board. Acceptance item 1 should read 'lists To Do as B, A, C'.

order.title: DataArray sort and sortBy keep the items that have the key in order and group the items without it at one end
order.rationale: Upheld ux/high. The comparator is not transitive, so every dashboard sorted by an optional field shows rows out of order.

order.title: Standard markdown images with a vault-relative path load from the vault
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. The documented ![](assets/x.png) form does not display. For the owner's vault, the resolved asset URL needs N-file-io-01's scope fix first.

order.title: Wikilink autocomplete inserts a non-markdown file with its extension, so ![[photo.png]] embeds the image
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. Picking an image from the popup inserts a stem that embeds as a note, a daily editor flow.

order.title: Enter in the quick switcher creates the note when nothing matches
order.rationale: Still present, ux/medium. In the daily Cmd+O, type, Enter flow, Enter does nothing when nothing matches.

order.title: Lens lists follow the user's own rename, move, delete, duplicate and create at once, not after the 2 to 10 s index throttle
order.rationale: Ux/medium. Daily lenses show stale rows for seconds after the user's own file operations.

order.title: A note-list inline rename that the file name rules refuse says why, like the folder rename does
order.rationale: Ux/medium. A title with ':' or '?' is a common input and today fails silently.

order.title: File History follows a note through rename, move, auto-move and suffixed restore
order.rationale: Still present, medium. Renames are common and leave the history panel empty. Note bytes are untouched, so this is wrong data on screen rather than lost content.

order.title: A text search shows only its own results: a query with no hits says No results found, even right after a tag click
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. After a tag click, the Search panel keeps showing the tag's list.

order.title: Text search with tag: or path: returns every note that matches the words and the operators, and tag: matches nested tags
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. The operators filter only the top 50 FTS hits and miss nested tags. It is in the same service as N-index-02, so it comes right after it.

order.title: Outgoing links marks a row as broken only when its target is missing: same-note heading links and embeds of existing files are not red
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. Image embeds and [[#Heading]] links show as broken on every note that has them.

order.title: Numeric <, <=, > and >= filters never match a note that lacks the property
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. A daily view lists the wrong notes, and no test pins the current ordering.

order.title: Renaming a kanban lane keeps its card limit, auto-complete and collapsed state
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. A lane rename drops the lane's settings on a daily-used board.

order.title: Canvas file nodes preview the note without its YAML frontmatter
order.rationale: Ux/medium. Any typed or tagged note placed on a canvas previews its raw YAML.

order.title: Canvas Duplicate places the copy next to the node's current position and size
order.rationale: Ux/medium. After a node has been dragged or resized, Duplicate uses its stale position.

order.title: Renaming or moving a note updates [[links]] in kanban cards and file nodes in canvases
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. Board links dangle after a rename. Rewriting canvas file nodes depends on the stored path format and resolver from Issue 17.

order.title: A QueryJS block run in the seconds after a save shows the saved data once the index catches up, and never keeps a pre-save result
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. A dashboard opened right after an edit keeps showing the stale result.

order.title: kb.pages('"folder"') returns the notes in that folder and its subfolders only
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. In common PARA layouts, a folder source also matches unrelated folders.

order.title: The Tasks view treats only done and cancelled tasks as completed: [/], [!], [?] and [>] tasks stay listed under Hide completed
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium. Open tasks are hidden by default. The suggested fix also reverses a pinned Rust toggle contract.
order.owner_question: Overlaps `.scratch/tasks-view/issues/02-guarded-status-preserving-toggle.md`, `.scratch/tasks-view/issues/06-open-closed-rule.md`, which another session was writing while this audit ran (untracked at the time). Keep this Issue or that one, and close the other. Toggling an in-progress [/] task: (a) write [x] (done), which reverses the pinned test toggle_task_in_content_in_progress_to_unchecked at parsing.rs:3272-3276, or (b) keep writing [ ] and change only the view's filter, icon and stats to read status.

order.title: The Tasks view keeps its list and scroll position on screen while it refreshes after a toggle or an index update
order.rationale: Ux/medium. Every tick in a long list blanks the list and resets the scroll position.
order.owner_question: Overlaps `.scratch/tasks-view/issues/04-mounted-list-and-rule-sentence.md`, which another session was writing while this audit ran (untracked at the time). Keep this Issue or that one, and close the other.

order.title: Auto Move evaluates and moves only Markdown notes: kanban boards, canvases and other files stay where they are
order.rationale: Upheld ux/medium, but it needs Auto Move enabled with a matching rule, so it is placed late in the medium group.

order.title: Leaving the theme editor any way other than Save puts the active theme back on the app
order.rationale: Ux/medium. Esc, X or Cmd+, leaves the unsaved preview theme painted on the app.

order.title: The relationship picker navigates with arrow keys
order.rationale: Partially fixed: the kanban picker already has arrow keys, so only RelationshipSearch remains and the title is narrowed to it.

order.title: Settings > Update keeps the download progress and Restart to update across closing Settings or changing section, and a second check cannot start a second download
order.rationale: Ux/medium, but updates are an occasional flow, so it is placed at the end of the medium group.

order.title: Paste, cut and copy inside a meta-bind number or date input act on the input, not the note
order.rationale: Ux/low. Meta-bind is daily, and the clipboard keys land in the note text. It is first among the low items because it is live preview.

order.title: HTML link paste keeps bracketed link text and table cells intact
order.rationale: Upheld ux/low. Mangled paste text is visible right away and can be undone.

order.title: An image embed with a WIDTHxHEIGHT size (300x200) applies both the width and the height
order.rationale: Upheld ux/low. Only the documented WxH form is affected, and only display size changes.

order.title: Cmd+click on a reference link or an email autolink opens its target, and a link with no openable URL is not sent to the opener
order.rationale: Ux/low. These are documented link forms that are rarely used.

order.title: Copy Block Link reuses only a real trailing block ID; a line ending in [[Note#^id]] or x^2 gets a new ID
order.rationale: Upheld ux/low. A broken link lands on the clipboard, and the note on disk is untouched.

order.title: Backlinks and Outgoing links show a load error with Retry, not an empty message
order.rationale: Still present, ux/low. It edits the same fetch functions as N-index-01, so it runs after that Issue to avoid a conflict.

order.title: Settings > File History > Automatic snapshots takes effect on the next save, with no vault reopen
order.rationale: Ux/low. This is a setting that is rarely toggled.

order.title: The Tags view keeps its list and expanded tags on screen while it refreshes
order.rationale: Ux/low. The list blanks for about 1 s and collapses on each refresh.

order.title: Clearing the search box while a search is still running shows the empty-query hint, not a stuck Searching...
order.rationale: Ux/low. It needs the search box cleared while a search is still running.

order.title: A tag click lists the notes with that tag even when Semantic or Hybrid was the selected search mode
order.rationale: Ux/low. It needs the search mode switched away from Text first.

order.title: Fuzzy search finds a close spelling wherever it sits in the vocabulary, not only among the first 500 words with the same first letter
order.rationale: Upheld ux/low. It needs a vocabulary of more than 500 words for one letter.

order.title: A formula that calls an unknown function cannot be confirmed and shows why
order.rationale: Ux/low. A formula typo fails silently.

order.title: Clearing a canvas node's color or a link node's title is saved to the .canvas file
order.rationale: Upheld ux/low. A cleared attribute comes back, and clearing one is uncommon.

order.title: file.inlinks lists the notes that link to a note whose name contains a dot
order.rationale: Upheld ux/low. Dotted note names are uncommon, and the effect is wrong counts on screen.

order.title: Vault open creates every missing placeholder template, including the parent folders periodic-note/ and quick-capture/
order.rationale: Upheld ux/low. Only empty placeholder templates go missing, and only on a fresh vault.

order.title: Todoist sync tells the user when it could not reach Todoist or the token was rejected
order.rationale: Ux/low. A sync that is offline or has a bad token fails silently.
order.owner_question: Overlaps `.scratch/tasks-view/issues/20-todoist-sync-errors-visible.md`, which another session was writing while this audit ran (untracked at the time). Keep this Issue or that one, and close the other.

order.title: New File from Template says the name is taken instead of silently opening the existing note
order.rationale: Ux/low. It needs a name that collides with an existing note.

order.title: Quick Switcher Create with a folder path (Projects/Idea) creates the note in that folder, and a failed create says why
order.rationale: Ux/low. A path-style create into a folder that does not exist is uncommon.

order.title: Dragging a node in the graph moves that node; dragging the background pans
order.rationale: Ux/low. The graph view is not in the owner's daily list.

order.title: Switching the graph Arrows toggle redraws the graph at once, also after the layout has settled
order.rationale: Ux/low. The graph view is not in the owner's daily list.

order.title: Live preview paints no active-line background; source mode keeps it
order.rationale: Partially fixed, polish/high. The cursor already lands on the body (editor.logic.ts:110-123), so only the active-line fill remains, and it shows on every note opened.

order.title: Editor tables use the full content width, with hover controls overlaid and the gap below the table kept
order.rationale: Polish/medium on the daily tables. The reservation is in the wrapper padding at styles.ts:376-379.

order.title: The status bar note count follows notes created, imported and deleted during the session
order.rationale: Polish/medium. The count stays at the vault-open value for the whole session.

order.title: The Tags view explains when the rare-tag filter hides everything
order.rationale: Still present, polish/medium. It is an empty-state message.

order.title: Word count and graph stats read correctly for zero and one
order.rationale: Still present, a copy fix.

order.title: Hovering the open note keeps its fill, and the kanban lane grip appears on lane hover
order.rationale: Still present, a visual fix on daily rows.

order.title: The collection table reads as a table
order.rationale: Still present, polish/medium on daily views. A sticky header has to account for the inner overflow-auto at CollectionTableView.svelte:39.

order.title: The first semantic or hybrid search after a one-file index update does not reload the whole search cache
order.rationale: Performance fine-tuning (about 2.5 s once per index change). The Issue itself requires the owner decision first.
order.owner_question: Search cache after an index update: option A, B or C as described in the Issue (for example keep the cache and patch the changed file's rows, or reload it in the background), recorded in Notes with the Issue 24 timing numbers.

order.title: Kanban date proximity has one token-based map, and done cards drop it
order.rationale: A visual fix on daily boards. The checked-card behavior is a recommended but unconfirmed owner decision. Issues 48 and 63 build on it.
order.owner_question: Should checked (done) kanban cards show no date proximity tone (recommended), or keep the tone they have today?

order.title: The New event dialog shows "Enter a title." only after the title was touched
order.rationale: Still present. It is error-timing fine-tuning in a flow the owner does not use daily.

order.title: The command palette shows dense one-line rows with key hints
order.rationale: Polish/medium. CommandDialog is shared with QuickSwitcher, TemplatePicker and OneOnOnePicker, which the Issue does not mention.
order.owner_question: Apply the denser rows to the shared CommandDialog, which also changes the Quick Switcher, Template picker and One-on-one picker, or only to the command palette?

order.title: Opening Settings moves focus into the drawer, and closing returns it
order.rationale: Still present. It is keyboard focus fine-tuning, and its blocker 28 is delivered.

order.title: A click in the audio player wrapper's padding moves the cursor like a click next to the widget
order.rationale: Still present, polish/low in live preview. The owner's manual check in the app follows the agent's fix.

order.title: Every language the code-block dropdown and the guide offer is syntax-highlighted
order.rationale: Polish/low. Only a few languages are missing.

order.title: The Markdown guide's Quick Reference shows block math in the three-line $$ form the editor renders
order.rationale: Re-rated polish: a docs-only fix. The parser contract stays pinned by math.test.ts:49-53.

order.title: The auto-move example's steps move the notes as written: edit then save, the right default delay, rules loaded after copying the file
order.rationale: Polish/low. It is a docs and example fix.

order.title: The personal-week kanban example uses the valid sortMode "checked", and the docs say the sort is per board
order.rationale: Polish/low. It is an example and docs fix.

order.title: The Periodic Notes help shows format examples that escape literal words with [ ]
order.rationale: Re-rated polish: a documentation fix, since the shipped defaults escape correctly.

order.title: The Tasks help says the default view lists only tasks under a #to-list heading, and that the date filter uses the note's modification date
order.rationale: Re-rated polish: a documentation fix only.

order.title: A calendar day with more than three notes lets the user reach every note
order.rationale: Polish/low. It needs a calendar view with a busy day.

order.title: A kb.table, kb.ui.table or kb.list cell holding an array or DataArray of links renders each link as a clickable link
order.rationale: Polish/low. It is a rendering nicety for a Dataview idiom.

order.title: The Search panel stops repeating the index status the status bar already shows
order.rationale: Polish/low. The Issue assumes an owner decision that is not recorded.
order.owner_question: Which surface keeps the index count: the status bar (recommended; remove the Search panel's row), or the panel (hide SearchStatus while the Search lens is open)?

order.title: Retention days and Debounce delay accept typed values and clamp on commit
order.rationale: Ux/low. It is input fine-tuning on fields edited rarely, and the stored value is already clamped.

order.title: Kanban cards drop the empty date row until hover or focus, and the date trigger stays keyboard reachable
order.rationale: Drafted without a deep dive, and it needs a keyboard-reachability decision. It is blocked by 47.
order.owner_question: Hide the empty date row until hover: confirm it stays reachable by keyboard through focus-within or opacity (not display:none), or drop the ticket.

order.title: Status colors use theme tokens, and a test forbids raw palette classes
order.rationale: Polish/low. Its guard test flags 47's kanban sites, so it cannot go green before 47 lands. Blocker 08 is resolved.

order.title: Canvas nodes, edges and grid draw from theme tokens, so they show on light themes
order.rationale: Polish/low. It matters only on light themes. Cite the new shadow lines :777,781.

order.title: Canvas menus, pickers and edge labels use theme tokens
order.rationale: Polish/low. It keeps its Blocked-by 43.

order.title: Toasts and the editor's CodeMirror base follow the theme mode
order.rationale: Polish/low. Its blocker 39 is done, and it matters only on a light theme.

order.title: The graph view paints with the active theme's colors
order.rationale: Polish/low. The Default background change is a recommended but unconfirmed owner decision.
order.owner_question: Default theme graph background: move from #1a1a1e to the editor background #2a2e3d (recommended), or keep #1a1a1e?

order.title: Settings is modal: a scrim closes it on outside click and Tab stays inside
order.rationale: It is design work that assumes an unrecorded owner decision, and it is blocked by 29.
order.owner_question: Make the Settings drawer modal (scrim, outside-click close, Tab trap), or keep the app behind it interactive and drop this ticket?

order.title: Help text that belongs to a settings row sits inside that row through a SettingItem hint prop
order.rationale: Partially fixed layout tidiness. The UpdateSection item is obsolete, and the Sentry paragraph keeps its current visibility.

order.title: Graph controls and the event dialog use shadcn Select, Switch and Checkbox
order.rationale: Polish/low, in surfaces that are not daily.

order.title: Search results and link rows reserve a gutter for their hover actions
order.rationale: Polish/low. It shows only on event notes.

order.title: The Default theme drops its Catppuccin preview overrides
order.rationale: Design polish. Its blocker 41 is resolved.

order.title: Right sidebar sections share one header recipe and one left edge
order.rationale: It is visual consistency work, not a defect, and its mismatch is smaller since Issue 50.

order.title: Chrome icon buttons share sizes and use shadcn tooltips
order.rationale: Design polish. Its blocker 37 is resolved.

order.title: Settings groups render as cards with dividers
order.rationale: Design polish that ends with the owner's visual check. Its blocker 24 is resolved.

order.title: .view toolbar and icon writes keep the file's YAML comments
order.rationale: What remains is section 3 only: sections 1-2 duplicate audit-2026-11-04 Issue 14, and section 4 is fixed. Every filter or sort change on a commented .view deletes the comments from disk. Views are daily and agents now write .view files, so this stays in content at low likelihood.
order.critique_notes: The title still promises 'a toolbar write is not reverted by a dirty tab's autosave'. At HEAD that part is fixed: every .view writer goes through rewriteViewFile (type-definitions.service.ts:350-440, commit 3df680423), and the verdict marks it (4) fixed. Only the comment loss remains (yaml-parser.ts:175-261, type-sidebar.logic.ts:520-570).

order.title: An external change to an open note is never overwritten by the next autosave or calendar write
order.rationale: Data loss that cannot be recovered, but it needs another editor to write while the tab is dirty, a 2 s window. The fix changes the pinned 'editor always wins' test.
order.owner_question: When a dirty tab's note changed on disk since it was loaded: (a) keep the external version as a File History snapshot or conflict copy, then save and toast, (b) reload from disk and drop the in-app typing, or (c) keep 'editor always wins', which is pinned by editor.service.test.ts 'skips dirty tabs, editor always wins'.

order.title: A note deleted or renamed outside the app is closed or marked orphaned, never recreated by the next autosave
order.rationale: No bytes are lost, and it needs an external rename or delete of an open note followed by typing in it.

order.title: A watcher rescan (dropped FSEvents) reloads open tabs before the next save
order.rationale: It needs dropped FSEvents on top of an external edit.

order.title: An unparseable .canvas opens in an error state and is never overwritten by canvas edits
order.rationale: Issue 15 has the same root cause (parseCanvas returns an empty canvas), and this Issue carries the owner decision. Its blocker 01 is resolved. It needs a broken .canvas file.

order.title: File History Restore writes the snapshot into the note shown in the dialog, never into whichever tab is active
order.rationale: It overwrites an unrelated note, but only after a tab change while the modal is open.

order.title: A meta-bind button stops its remaining actions when an open action fails
order.rationale: Low: it needs a button whose open action fails. It goes first in the shared action switch that Issue 48 changes next.

order.title: A meta-bind button's updateMetadata always writes the button's own note, also after an open or createNote action
order.rationale: It writes into an unrelated note, but only for a button that puts open or createNote before updateMetadata. It builds on Issue 10's open result.

order.title: Keystrokes typed during link rewrite, type rename or watcher reload writes are kept
order.rationale: It is a race in a window of milliseconds. The calendar-delete part is narrowed by f1b3cde9d.

order.title: Dock Quit, logout and shutdown run the exit flush before the app ends
order.rationale: The loss is at most the last 2 s of typing, and only when quitting right after typing. The owner checks the result in the app.

order.title: Note writes are atomic: a failed write never leaves the note empty or truncated
order.rationale: Severe but improbable: it needs a write to fail midway (disk full or a crash).

order.title: Rename link rewrite skips links inside code blocks and updates self links
order.rationale: Partially fixed: the path-qualified and extension halves are done (99bffdf66, fdf1479c2). What remains needs links inside code blocks.

order.title: Root unarchive writes vault/x.md, auto-move refuses .. segments, and a case or NFC variant of a path reuses the open tab
order.rationale: Its canvas double-prefix section is covered by Issue 17. The rest needs Auto Move (opt-in) or a folder-case mismatch.

order.title: Deep-link names resolve safely: .md is added unless the name ends in a real extension, name=. stays inside the vault, and overwrite never replaces .kokobrain files
order.rationale: Same fix site: resolveFilePath at utils/path.ts:33-53. It is reachable only from hand-built external URLs, because in-app Copy deep link includes the extension.

order.title: Deep-link prepend goes below the frontmatter, and non-silent new keeps <% %> in the sent text
order.rationale: It is reachable only from external kokobrain:// URLs with prepend. Quick Capture does not use this path.

order.title: Duplicate saves the note's unsaved typing before copying it
order.rationale: Upheld ux/low. Only the copy is stale, and only within the 2 s debounce.

order.title: Duplicate never overwrites a sibling whose name differs only in case (APFS)
order.rationale: It needs case-variant siblings. It is next to N-file-io-07 because both change duplicateItem.

order.title: An unreadable or corrupt trash manifest is backed up, never replaced by a partial list, and trash writers never orphan trashed items

verdicts.reason: I could not refute it. MarkdownEditor.svelte:627 reads selection.main.head from the old doc, and replaceDoc:182-186 dispatches the docDiff changes together with an explicit EditorSelection.cursor(cursorPos). CodeMirror does not map an explicit selection, so after Cmd+D inserts `_favorite: true` above the caret, the caret sits about 16 chars too early. Cmd+D is routed from inside the editor (global-keybindings.ts:189-196) to updateNoteFrontmatter, then syncExternalContentToEditor (frontmatter-write.service.ts:131), then the active-tab signal bump. No test asserts the caret after a sync. Text typed next lands at the wrong spot and autosave writes it to disk.

Confirmed at editor.service.ts:303-321. closeTab calls ask() for any dirty non-virtual tab and never cancels debouncedSave, so the 2 s timer can save the tab while the dialog is open. Exit goes through prepareForExit (save first, then ask only about saves that failed); closeTab does not. Nothing is lost unless the user explicitly picks Discard within the window, so this is ux.
verdicts.corrections: The pinned test begins at editor.service.test.ts:658 ('asks with Discard Changes / Cancel labels ...'). The reference is accurate.

verdicts.reason: tauri-listeners.service.ts:48-55 destroys the main window after prepareForExit. The run loop at lib.rs:392-396 matches only RunEvent::ExitRequested, there is no Reopen handler, and WebviewWindowBuilder is used only for the composer (lib.rs:136). app_exit.rs:46-48 itself describes the windowless state. dispatch_shortcut (lib.rs:45) checks only db::is_open(), so qc:capture-detected is emitted with no listener left. The tests at tauri-listeners.service.test.ts:224-311 pin destroy.
verdicts.corrections: Duplicate of N-file-io-03: same root cause and same fix site. Merge them into one Issue. N-file-io-03 already proposes hide + Reopen, while this one asks for an owner decision between (a) and (b).

verdicts.reason: completion.ts:71-82 labels and inserts file.nameWithoutExt for every candidate. listLinkCandidates excludes only .view (isLinkTargetFile), so images and PDFs are offered by stem. isImageEmbed needs an extension, so `![[photo]]` becomes a note embed, and the stem key in buildResolutionCache resolves it to photo.png, which readTextFile then reads. Re-rated to ux: the bad text is the inserted link, the user sees the broken embed at once, and no existing content is corrupted. A plain `[[photo]]` link still resolves.
verdicts.corrections: Category content -> ux. The resolution evidence lines are wikilink-resolution.logic.ts:110-145 (the cache build is at :111-126 and the stem fallback is in resolveWikilinkCached), not exactly :113-118/:139.

verdicts.reason: Confirmed. BLOCK_ID_RE = /\^([^\s]+)\s*$/ (navigation.logic.ts:9) matches 'abc123]]' in `[[Meeting#^abc123]]` and '2' in `m^2`. detectBlockElement then reports it as existingBlockId, and copy-block-link.service.ts:46-47 reuses it without appending a new ID. The result is a broken link on the clipboard, while the note on disk is untouched, so this is ux rather than content.

verdicts.reason: The frontmatter is always hidden with per-line replace decorations (hide-lines.ts:14-20), and it is not revealed when the cursor enters it. rg finds no atomicRanges, transactionFilter or changeFilter under src/lib. frontmatterClick only handles the mouse, and its comment says keyboard moves are not changed. The e2e at frontmatter.spec.ts:53-65 shows ArrowUp lands on a hidden line. Backlinks at the start of a non-empty first body line merge it with the closing `---`. Enter after Cmd+Up splits the opening fence. Either way findFrontmatterBlock stops matching and autosave writes broken frontmatter. Nothing guards this path.

paste-html-link.logic.ts:90 interpolates the anchor text unescaped, so `[1]` becomes `[[1]](url)`, which WIKILINK_DECORATION_RE matches. BLOCK_TAGS (:21-26) has TABLE and TR but no TD or TH, so cells in a row are fused. The handler runs before pasteTsvHandler (live-preview.ts:104). Re-rated to ux: the mangled text appears right away at paste time and can be undone, and the source text is not lost.

` (paste-tsv.logic.ts:130). Markdown links in cells therefore show as raw text. The help example 10-tables.md expects a link in a cell to render. This is rendering only, and the doc on disk is fine, so it is ux.

EditorView.svelte:79-80 mounts KanbanView without a key and with onContentChange, which writes tabs[activeIndex] (editor.store.svelte.ts:84-88), unlike canvas, which uses onContentChangeForPath inside a key block. The card edit commits only on blur or Enter (KanbanCard.svelte:69-101, :195). On a keyboard tab switch or Cmd+W the edit is either dropped or, if blur fires during teardown, applyChange compares against the new tab's content prop and writes the board markdown into the note now in front. A mouse click on a tab blurs first and commits safely, which keeps likelihood low. As the Issue says, whether WebKit fires blur on removal was not verified.

Confirmed. deep-link-actions.ts:176-188 puts raw title, sourceTitle, sourceApp and url into vars, and the shipped help/examples/templates/Quick Note.md has them unquoted (`title: <% title %>`, `source_title: <% sourceTitle %>`). A page title with ': ' gives invalid YAML, and ' #' truncates the value as a comment. The note is still written (:226-229), and the lossy check only gates the title/tags injection. Browser titles with ': ' are common, and the written note's frontmatter ends up corrupted or truncated on disk.

Confirmed. parsing.rs:1633 and :1650 set checked to check_char != ' ', and filterCompletedTasks and computeTaskStats (tasks.logic.ts:35-53, :103) read checked as done, so [/], [!], [?] and [>] tasks are hidden under the default Hide completed. EventTaskChip.svelte:16-18 already works around this with status. No test pins in-progress as completed. These are open tasks hidden from view, with no data loss.
verdicts.corrections: Category ux. The fix direction also changes what toggle_task_in_content writes ([/] becomes [x] instead of [ ]), which reverses a test-pinned contract (parsing.rs:3272-3276). Flag that change as an owner decision rather than an implementation detail.

verdicts.reason: Confirmed. ensureTemplatesFolder (templates.service.ts:99-124) creates only the templates root via create_folder, then calls writeTextFile into `periodic-note/` and `quick-capture/` subfolders with no mkdir. plugin-fs 2.7.1 WriteFileOptions has no recursive option, and the single catch stops the loop at the first failure. The impact is missing empty placeholder files on a fresh vault only, so no content is lost.

verdicts.reason: Confirmed. notifyAfterSave clears the QueryJS results (editor.hooks.ts:81-83), but execute reads getVaultEntries() (queryjs-block-widget.ts:243), which is memoized on vaultIndexVersion (vault-entries.service.ts:26-29). That version is bumped only in the throttled refresh (tauri-listeners.service.ts:106-109, :267-268, 2 s or 10 s), and requestPromptIndexRefresh is not called on a plain save. A run in that window caches a pre-save result via setResult (:270), and nothing in queryjs listens on vaultIndexVersion to drop it. A stale dashboard is shown, but no file is written.
verdicts.corrections: Category ux, not content: the dashboard shows stale data and nothing is written.

verdicts.reason: Confirmed. buildReverseIndex keys targets by getBasename(link.target) (queryjs.logic.ts:53), and getBasename strips after the last dot, so 'Dr. Silva' becomes 'dr'. resolveInlinks then looks up 'dr. silva' (:76-77), so the note gets no inlinks and 'Dr.md' receives them instead. Dotted note names are uncommon, and the result is wrong counts on screen.
